notes.title: Version 0.8.10 (rhythmic visuals)
notes.content:
Pulsating particles in the background
Pulsating hero circle around
Zoom/blur effects on the beat
More particles on higher graphic settings
More fog at start of level 2
New flash-effects with glow for bullets
Mouse cursor is hidden

notes.title: Version 0.8.9
notes.content:
Range of bullet explosions is indicated with circles
Adjusted rhythm pattern in first stage
Adjusted timing in tutorial
Fixed a bug with background speed in stage 3
Improved refresh rate test

notes.title: Version 0.8.8 (3 difficulty levels)
notes.content:
3 difficulty levels:
-casual: for most players the best option for the first playtrough
-serious: for shmup veterans and people who have completed the casual course
-insane: for players looking for the ultimate challenge

Bullets glow in complementary color
Glow effect on titles
Various minor improvements

notes.title: Version 0.8.7 (Remastered graphics with animations and shaders)
notes.content:
Animations for all enemies and bosses
Shadows and displacementfilters for background images
Shadows for enemies
Effects synchronized with the music
Outline or glow filters for enemies that indicate the beat
Various other filters
Many minor improvements and fixes

P.S. The changes are not present in the demo or the screenshots yet, just in the full game.

notes.title: Version 0.8.6
notes.content:
Standard gamepads are automatically recognised
Simplified startup screen
Range and charge of shield is indicated with a circle around the player
New lifebar style
Cancels all bullets when hit
New sounds for combos
Better performance due to new Pixi.js version 7

notes.title: Version 0.8.5
notes.content:
Added a combo system
Judges precision of the beat
Particles fly to enemy
Star collectables
Adjusted the animation before a beat
New game over screen and music
The hardest 2 acts are a bit easier

notes.title: Version 0.8.4 Updates
notes.content:
Animations before bullets flash makes it easier keep the rhythm
Bullets pulsate to the rhythm and outline white when flashing
Stage 3-2: New enemy behaviour
Score animation towards total score
Enhanced particle effect for exploding bullets
Epilepsy warning
Various bug fixes

notes.title: Version 0.8.3 Updates
notes.content:
Bosses give feedback on their health (smoke).
Bosses are more aggressive when low on health.
Faster shield recharge and new particle effects.
Shadowed sprites and other graphical improvements.
Minimized framerate drops by preloading sprites.
Compatible mode with not 60 hz monitor refresh rates. Autodetect refresh rate.
Various bug fixes
